1.title: Cross rope to make loop
1.say: Hold the long blue rope upright in your left hand. Cross the short loose end over the front of the long part.
placements: short loose end of blue rope → crossed over front of long hanging part from right side to left side to form open loop below, in the video: open loop centered with short end pointing left
watch_for: If the end goes under instead of over, the crossing will look backwards and will not twist right.
If the lower loop is very small, leave more rope so you have enough length to finish the knot.
1.check_yourself: It should look like one open loop hanging down with the short loose end lying across the front to the left.

2.title: Take end behind and around
2.say: Hold the crossing steady with your left hand. Bring the short loose end of the blue rope behind the long part. Pull it out to the right.
placements: short loose end of blue rope → passed behind long hanging part and out to right side to make upper twist, in the video: short end sticks out to the right behind upright rope above lower loop
watch_for: If you bring the end across the front again, you will see no twist on top and the shape collapses.
If the end points left after, you went the wrong way so move it behind to point right.
2.check_yourself: It should look like a small twist on top with the short loose end sticking out sideways behind and a big open loop below.

3.title: Thread end through and tighten
3.say: Push the short loose end of the blue rope forward through the lower loop. Pull both ends of the blue rope slowly to tighten.
placements: short loose end of blue rope → pushed forward through center of lower open loop from back to front then pulled down to snug, with long end up and short end down, in the video: tight upright eight with two stacked loops
watch_for: If you push through from the front, the rope will not make the eight shape with two stacked loops.
If the knot looks loose and wobbly, pull both ends again until both loops sit snug.
3.check_yourself: It should look like the number eight upright with two snug loops stacked and a short end hanging straight down.
